newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan doesn't welcome excessive forex moves -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan doesn't welcome excessive forex moves -- MOF.

text.p: Japan does not welcome an excessive sharpening or weakening of the yen, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday.

Asked about Japan's stance on currencies ahead of the Group of Seven (G7) nations' meeting at the weekend, Mitsuzuka said Japan would state its views on currencies at the meeting and added that it considered an excessive strengthening or weakening of the yen undesirable.
"It is important for macro economies for currencies to stabilise," he said.
Mitsuzuka also said that the G7 nations' stance of cooperating in seeking stable currency rates remained unchanged.

The minister said that recent movements in the currency markets were the result of a "singular strengthening of the dollar". He said the U.S. currency had risen against the mark as well as against the yen.
